sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:77335
Court No. - 85
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 48895 of 2023

Applicant :- Rajkishor
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Aakash Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Guru Prasad

Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

Heard Sri Aakash Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State as well as
Sri Guru Prasad, learned counsel for the complainant and perused the record.
2.

This is the repeat bail application filed on behalf of the accused-applicant Rajkishor with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No.316 of 2022, under Sections 376-D, 313, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Karvi, District Chitrakoot.
3. The first bail application of the accused-applicant has been decided on merits and it has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 1.6.2023.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the evidence of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the trial court as P.W.1 and there are several contradictory statements in her statement which also contradict her previous statements recorded under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
The statement of the victim made in the cross-examination reveals that no medicine was administered by the applicant for the abortion of the prosecutrix and it was not a case of gang rape.

Rajkishor vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27465425/

entities.text: Rajkishor vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that except the statement of the prosecutrix, there is no cogent evidence on record to show the guilt of the applicant in this case.
It is also submitted that the victim of this case is a major lady and this case does not fall within the ambit of POCSO Act.
It is further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 17.08.2022.

5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the complainant opposed the bail prayer and submitted that there is no new or additional ground for considering the grant of bail in the second bail application.
The first bail application of the applicant was rejected on merits by this Court vide order dated 1.6.2023.
6. The ground taken by the learned counsel for the applicant in the repeat bail application relates to the merits of this case.
It cannot be adjudicated at this stage and several points have already been discussed in the first bail rejection order.
I do not find it a fit case to allow the second bail application of the accused-applicant.
7. The second bail application of the accused-applicant is hereby rejected.
